verdict.rationale: Logseq presents itself as a privacy-first, local-data knowledge base, and its sync is documented as end-to-end encrypted. Together these structurally limit the vendor's access to user content, and community users value the local-data model. However, nothing in the pack addresses AI model training directly: there is no stated no-training policy and no opt-out control. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is not used for AI training, a user-facing training opt-out or data-use control, and independent verification of data-use practices.
